title: Brand Manifest (brand.yaml)
description: Validates the parsed contents of ./brand/brand.yaml (or ./brands/<slug>/brand.yaml): brand identity, file inventory with last-updated timestamps and owning skills, and active campaigns. Created by /start-here; every skill that writes a profile file updates its files entry in the same operation. brand_context.py uses the timestamps for freshness flags (falling back to file mtime when the manifest is absent).

slug.description: Kebab-case slug; matches the ./brands/<slug>/ directory name in agency mode.

created.description: ISO 8601 date the brand profile was first created.

updated.description: ISO 8601 date of the most recent write to any profile file.

category.description: What the business is, in plain words: 'plumber', 'B2B SaaS for dentists', 'newsletter'.

depth.description: lite = the ~3 minute first run (site + reviews); deep = the four-agent foundation.

phone.description: Main phone number as shown on the site (local businesses).

services.description: Main services or products, in the business's own words.

rating.description: Review rating and count as seen, with source and date, e.g. '4.8 (212 Google reviews, seen 2026-11-13)'.

files.description: Inventory of brand-memory files, keyed by filename (e.g. 'voice-profile.md' or user-authored 'preferences.md').

updated.description: ISO 8601 date this file was last written.

owner.description: The skill that owns (creates/maintains) this file, e.g. 'brand-voice'.

notes.description: Optional free-text note, e.g. 'partial: voice only, no platform adaptations yet'.

campaigns.description: Campaigns this brand is running or has run.

name.description: Kebab-case campaign name, matching its ./campaigns/<name>/ directory.

path.description: Path to the campaign directory, e.g. './campaigns/spring-launch/'.
